lines.text: Jehoshaphat succeeded Asa and strengthened himself against Israel by stationing troops in every fortified city of Judah.
The LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of David and did not seek the Baals.
Jehoshaphat's heart delighted in the LORD's ways, and he removed the golden calves of Bethel and Dan from Judah.

wrong_details.wrong: golden calves of Bethel and Dan

lines.text: In the third year of his reign, Jehoshaphat sent officials, Levites and priests to teach Judah, carrying the ark of the covenant.

wrong_details.true: the Book of the Law of the LORD

lines.text: The dread of the LORD fell on the surrounding kingdoms, and the Arabs brought Jehoshaphat rams and goats from their flocks.
